rules.name: Dispirited Enemy
rules.description: The morale of the enemy facing you today is already shaky.  At the start of the German player's first turn he must automatically take a battle counter.

rules.name: Artillery Radio Link Vehicle
rules.description: An Artillery Radio Link Vehicle can attempt to repeat any off-table artillery (not mortar) barrage.  After any artillery barrage (off-table, requested, timed, etc.) has been completed, roll a D6.  On a roll of '6' the barrage is immediately repeated, aimed at the same target point.  Start from 'Fire for Effect' all over again, using the same quantity and caliber of guns as the previous barrage.  It does not cost any Orders to fire this repeat barrage.  Counter battery fire missions can be used against this extra barrage.  Once the Artillery Radio Link Vehicle has successfully called in a repeat barrage, this ability cannot be used again in the game.

rules.name: Time on Target Barrage
rules.description:
Each Time on Target barrage allows the US player to declare an artillery (not mortar) barrage as Time on Target.  This does not count as an Additional Fire Support selection.

When rolling for Artillery Barrage Accuracy, any results of a 1 can be re-rolled with the second result standing.

sharedRules.name: Fire Superiority
sharedRules.description:
Treats all Area Fire as one band higher than its actual Rate of Fire.

ie: RoF = 3 would use the 5-9 band; RoF = 5 would use the 10+ band.

Fire Supperiority has no effect on Aimed Fire.

sharedRules.name: HVSS
sharedRules.description: A tank with Horizontal Volume Suspension Springs (HVSS) increases its cross-country and road movement distances by 1".  This will already be included in the vehicle's data profile.

sharedRules.name: Additional Armor
sharedRules.description: Any M4 Sherman (any variant), M5 Stuart, M10, M18, or M36 Tank Destroyer can be upgraded with Additional Armor. This provides +1 to the front armor rating of the vehicle against panzerfausts and panzerschrecks.
